api_gotchas.note: Cac diem hay nham khi dung geotech-staff-engineer — da test thuc te 2026-05-16

settlement_time_factor.signature: time_factor(cv: float, t: float, Hdr: float)
settlement_time_factor.cv_unit: m2/s — dat set mem dien hinh cv ~ 5e-8 m2/s
settlement_time_factor.wrong: time_factor(t_years=1.0, cv=...) — khong co kwarg t_years
settlement_time_factor.degree_of_consolidation_return: tra ve % (0-100), KHONG phai 0-1 — dung {U:.1f}% chu khong phai {U:.1%}

SlopeSoilLayer.wrong: slope_height, slope_angle — khong ton tai, phai dung surface_points

SlopeGeometry_surface_points.format: List[Tuple[float, float]] — list cac diem (x, y) tren mat dat
SlopeGeometry_surface_points.note: Mat trot phai cat qua surface_points tai 2 diem — neu khong raise ValueError

analyze_braced_excavation.correct: analyze_braced_excavation(geometry=geom)  — geom chua soil_layers va support_levels
analyze_braced_excavation.support_levels_param: SupportLevel(depth=1.0)  — depth tinh tu dinh, khong phai elevation
analyze_braced_excavation.support_reactions_type: List[Dict] — lay gia tri: d.get('reaction_kN_per_m') hoac list(d.values())[0]

wave_equation_blow_count.note: Blow count tang rat nhanh khi Rult lon — kiem tra thong so bua va coc truoc khi tin ket qua
wave_equation_blow_count.typical_range: Rult < 500 kN voi Delmag D30-32 tren coc SW-840 ~ 10-50 blows/m
